Excellent mid/low priced Indian restaurant
Jan 2024 • Couples
Excellent place for Indian food. We enjoyed ourselves for a fair price. It's not a very cheap place as indicated, on the price scale in Vietnam but it's still very affordable.

They have a wine list but none of the 8-10 bottles offered were in stock. We found this point a little lamentable. Either you offer wines and you have them, or you don't put them on the menu (even more so on a separate wine list...)

We still give a good 5 stars because the surplus was perfect and we clearly recommend this restaurant.

Ah yes... one more word about naan. Delicious and gargantuan!
